items.title: Phil Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 27, 2023
items.q: Al Belletto’s group for half a year going into the army

ctx.x: What did you do on the bus to pass the time? This was well before people could stare at their phones all day or well before having a disc player. How did you pass the time? © Fillius Jazz Archive -6-

Very, very comfortably in a way. I mean I’m — 18, 19, 20 I went out with the Dorseys at 20 and basically I stayed on the road until I left Woody’s band in ’67? It can’t be that long. I must be exaggerating. But still we’re talking the Dorsey band, Al Belletto’s group for half a year going into the army, the navy NORAD band — North American Air Defense Command — and that’s where I learned all my technique I know about how to microphone etcetera, etcetera. I learned how to get my own sound. I recorded all these…
Let me ask you some more about that. I may be a bit like you with arranging.
